questions.question: Which of these unions has Palesa Mapoo actually played for?
questions.explanation: Palesa Mapoo has represented: Badgers, Knights, Lions.

questions.question: Warriors set a database record (23/24 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 207. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Biggest Win by Runs', held by Warriors.

questions.question: At which ground did Rhinos record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 46, against Limpopo Lillies on 2019/02/03.

questions.question: "Eastern Storm" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: Easterns was rebranded Eastern Storm (not to be confused with Eastern Province, who became the Warriors).
